summary: Lam Research filed an 8-K reporting annual meeting results (Item 5.07) and, under Item 8.01, a press release announcing a $25 billion share repurchase authorization plus declaration of a quarterly dividend, dated November 5, 2026. All ten director nominees were elected; say-on-pay passed at 93.12% of votes cast and KPMG ratification at 99.33%. A stockholder proposal on the right to call special meetings failed with 42.22% support. Board recommendation and advisor are not stated; mechanics of the buyback (timing, method) are not disclosed in the excerpt. Watch pace of repurchase execution against free cash flow and any leverage shift.
